title: Cost of food/drink - Vietnam Forum
paragraphs: As others have stated it really depends where you eat. For a local soup or rice dish I pay between 25.000 and 50.000 Dong. But even for normal Vietnamese food places and restaurants the bill can easily get more than 300.000 Dong or more. But then it will include seafood. So it really depends what you want to eat.

You will also drink more than at home and you might want to take advantage of the fresh fruit juices and smoothies. So for a safe bet I would go on average of £50 for the four of you. It might be much cheaper if you really only eat Pho or Com Tam etc. But with kids I assume sometimes some Western food will be needed or you want to enjoy some grilled meat or seafood (which is still cheap here).

But sometimes you do not realise how quick you pay more (I am in Co To and paid for fresh grilled fish, some clams and veggie 700.000. it is still cheap but sometimes you pay more for nice food...even if it is mainly for Vietnamese).
